hints.text: Check which rows you selected. Are all of them from 2024, and are there exactly 12?
An annual mean is the arithmetic mean: add the 12 monthly anomalies and divide by 12. Copying values by hand often drops a minus sign or a digit.
Worked example with a different year: for 1980, filter Year = 1980, then =AVERAGE() over the 12 Anomaly_C cells. Apply the identical steps to 2024.
Your result looks like it is in a different temperature unit. Which unit does the Anomaly_C column use?
No unit conversion is needed: the data are already in °C. (A temperature difference converts with ×1.8 only, never +32.)
Your number looks like an absolute Fahrenheit temperature. Anomalies are differences, and the data are already in °C.
Your value is about 12 times too large. Did you add the months without dividing?
The digits look right but the decimal point is in the wrong place. Re-check how you typed the result.
Your value matches a neighbouring year. Check your Year filter.
Your result has the wrong sign. Was 2024 warmer or cooler than the 1951–1980 average?
Re-read the mission question: which unit and which 12 months define the 2024 calendar-year mean?
The protocol uses January–December of 2024 in °C. If you used a different window, recompute with the calendar year.
First confirm you have 50 annual means (1975 through 2024 inclusive) before fitting the line.
Ordinary least squares slope = Σ(x−x̄)(y−ȳ) / Σ(x−x̄)², with x = year and y = annual mean. Spreadsheets: =SLOPE(y, x). Python: numpy.polyfit(x, y, 1)[0].
Worked example with toy data: years 2000, 2001, 2002 with values 0.10, 0.14, 0.15 give a slope of 0.025 °C/year = 0.25 °C/decade. Use the same procedure on the 50 real annual means.
Your value is 10 times smaller than expected. Which time unit does the question ask for?
Your slope seems to be per month. Fit the line to annual means against the year, then convert to per decade.
Your trend has the wrong sign. Did you swap x and y order, or sort years descending with a reversed x-axis?
Your trend matches a much longer period. The protocol starts in 1975.
Check the recorded first year, last year and unit against the mission question.
